verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public programmatic surface for Skills. The Skills API uploads and manages custom skills, and a Skill Versions API handles versioning. Skills are attached in Messages API requests via the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request, by `skill_id`/`version`), and the Agent SDK lets code control which skills sessions can invoke and load plugins programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving skills through the API, and endpoint-level detail beyond create and versions.
